summary: Octopath Traveler entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Octopath Traveler

emulation.notes: Use native PC or platform-holder releases.

primary.version: Current Octopath Traveler Windows PC build
primary.why: Octopath Traveler is now broadly available, and the Windows route gives the cleanest capture/settings path for the original HD-2D RPG without adding platform-exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows build. Record storefront, patch/build, resolution, controller, protagonist start, chapter progress, optional jobs, side quests, and whether Switch/PlayStation/Xbox versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if preserving the original 2018 Switch release feel.
secondary.why: Switch is the launch route, but PC is easier to capture at high quality.
No sourced exclusive scenario content over the PC route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record platform and build; do not merge with Octopath Traveler II or Champions of the Continent.
